title: Valve releases Steam Controller CAD files under Creative Commons license
summary: Valve has released the CAD files for the Steam Controller under a Creative Commons license, allowing the community to freely access, modify, and 3D print components for repairs or custom projects. This move supports the right-to-repair movement and extends the lifespan of the discontinued hardware.
problem_solved: Enables the community to repair, modify, and customize Steam Controllers without depending on Valve's manufacturing, supporting hardware longevity.
why_valuable: Empowers users with hardware ownership rights and fosters an open-source hardware ecosystem around discontinued gaming peripherals.
